item.title: Pretty woodwork! Has a wine cellar and a humidor! C. 1910 in New Mexico. $289,000
item.description: Such pretty woodwork! How about that wine cellar and the walk in humidor. The house was built in 1910. It is located Carrizozo, New Mexico. The house features a covered front porch, hardwood floors, french doors, pretty staircase, built-in seating, exposed beams, built-in bookshelves, paneled wainscoting, bead board, crown moulding and a claw foot tub. There is a basement with a wine cellar and a humidor. The property has a detached garage. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,268 square feet. $2

item.title: Beautiful house! Beautiful setting! 15 acres in Virginia. $599,900
item.description: Beautiful house! Beautiful setting! Beautiful views! Really pretty area in Southwestern Virginia. The house was built in 1905. It is located on 15.74 acres in Independence, Virginia. The house features a large wrap around front porch, some original wood floors, crown moulding, pretty chandeliers, baseboards, picture rails, exposed beams, built-in window seating, pretty staircase, large upper hall and vintage light fixtures. item.title: Vintage charm in Nevada! Circa 1910. $239,000
item.description: This Nevada home has character and charm! It is a cute house and would be fun to decorate. The house was built in 1910. It is located in Ely, Nevada. The house features a covered front porch, original wood floors, built in china cabinet, wide baseboards, vintage kitchen, solid wood doors with original hardware, wainscoting and pressed tin ceiling. Five bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,853 square feet. $239,000 Contact Kenna K. Almberg with Desert Mountain Realty: 775-289-3038 From the Zillow listin

item.title: Pretty staircase and woodwork! C. 1900 in Ohio. $289,900
item.description: This house has a pretty staircase and woodwork! The house was built in 1900. It is located in Urbana, Ohio. The house features a covered back porch, fenced in backyard, pretty staircase, pocket doors, wood floors, crown moulding, leaded glass, bay windows, tall ceilings, updated kitchen, wainscoting, updated bathrooms, laundry room and a carport. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,738 square feet. $289,900 Contact V. Patrick Hamilton with RE/MAX Alliance Realty: 937-652-1100 From the Zillow lis

item.title: Love Tudor Style Homes! Incredible potential! C. 1930 in Ohio. $164,900
item.description: Love a good Tudor house! This one has a lot of potential! The house was built in 1930. It is located in Painesville, Ohio. The house features wood floors, wainscoting, chair rails, built-in corner china cabinet, exposed beams, baseboards, french doors and a back staircase. There is a large unfinished basement. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,727 square feet. $164,900 Contact Jayme M. Sandy with RE/MAX Results: 440-488-0415 From the Zillow listing: Endless Potential in a Classic Tudor at 120

item.title: Look at that setting! Has a guest house! Nine acres in Oregon. $899,000
item.description: Take a look at that setting! Feel like you might see Bigfoot walking around in there. There is a guesthouse on the property. The house was built in 1940. It is located on 9.39 acres in Portland, Oregon. The house features a great entryway with soaring ceilings and a wall of windows, parquet flooring, built-in bookshelves, stone fireplace and a spacious kitchen. There is a large basement. The guesthouse has two bedrooms and one bathroom. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,958 square feet. $899,00

item.title: Now that’s a stove! Stone Lion Inn Bed and Breakfast in Oklahoma. $675,000
item.description: How that is one heck of a stove! Love the huge porch! The Stone Lion Inn Bed and Breakfast was built in 1900. It is located on six acres in Guthrie, Oklahoma. The house features a large wrap around front porch, upper porch, a porte cochere, grand staircase, wood floors, pocket doors, large mantels, spacious kitchen, amazing stove, bay windows, wainscoting and a claw foot tub. There is a large sunroom and a large attic. Six bedrooms, seven bathrooms and 5,347 square feet. $675,000 Contact Carroll

item.title: Schoolhouse transformation! Circa 1890. Over an acre in Pennsylvania. $349,500
item.description: How about this schoolhouse transformation! They did a nice job. I like the yellow in the kitchen! The school was built in 1890. It is located on 1.45 acres in Reinholds, Pennsylvania. The house features a front porch, a screened in back porch, wood floors, old chalk boards, wainscoting, pressed tin ceiling, built-in bookshelves and a breakfast nook. There are a few outbuildings on the property. One bedroom, one bathroom and 1,543 square feet. $349,500 Contact Lisa Tiger with Century 21 Gold: 610

item.title: Love the long driveway! Circa 1852. Over two acres in South Carolina. $345,000
item.description: I love the long driveway! Such a pretty setting! The house was built in 1852. It is located on 2.53 acres in Lynchburg, South Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, a porte cochere, some wood floors, baseboards, crown moulding, knotty pine, brick fireplace, built-in bookshelves, bead board and chair rails. Not a fan of the flooring in the kitchen. Five bedrooms, two bathrooms and 3,176 square feet. $345,000 Contact Debbie Lee with The Litchfield Company: 803-938-3083 From the Zillow

item.title: Double porch love! Great staircase! C. 1898 in Texas. $325,000
item.description: Double porch love! Beautiful staircase and pocket doors! Really pretty features inside! The Webb-Schneider House was built in 1898. It is located in La Grange, Texas. The house features double front porches, pretty staircase, wood floors, wide baseboards, pocket doors, transom windows, crystal chandelier, nice kitchen sink and a claw foot tub. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,230 square feet. $325,000 Contact Marcie Naughton with CB&A Realtors: 713-418-0331 From the Zillow listing: A Historic
